partial_missing: fold-local median imputation + missing indicators; all-missing training columns retained as zero
all_feature_missing: retain null candidate row and abstain; do not train/score with no informative NDVI
sample_weight: class-balanced, then equal-country contribution within each class; weights fit on training rows only
validation: same official Maryland 44 rows with foreign training augmentation and original five farm folds
global_scope: repository multi-country subset, not worldwide coverage
limitations: Netherlands is a small local sample dominated by silage
Europe has labels but missing NDVI and dairy distances: pending enrichment, not measured accuracy
Point vs field NDVI and sparse vs dense sampling differ by source
Missingness can proxy source; source-held-out results are essential
2026 Maryland dairy locations not independently verified for historical years
No claim of new blind-test accuracy for repeatedly viewed Maryland data
